Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Jackson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 216 as introduced codifies current practice of the Alabama Board of Examiners in Marriage and Family Therapy to license, charge, and collect fees for marriage and family therapy associates, interns, and supervised roles. In fiscal year 2020, the board collected $18,275 in fees for these designations.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
